name: pricing_condition
title: Pricing condition records and scales target comparison
description: Pricing condition records and scales. Export every configured condition access table (Axxx or customer tables) at its actual DDIC key and link KNUMH to KONH/KONP and scales. KONH alone loses the customer/material/sales-area access key; the configured access export is mandatory. Include supplements, exclusions, deletion, validity, calculation-type-specific percentages/currencies/units and scale type. Never confuse master condition records with document conditions (KONV/PRCD_ELEMENTS), or divide every rate by the same factor.
